notes:
- Fixed a new install that could never finish setting up. One of the add-ons
  the studio needs could no longer be downloaded, so setup stopped at the same
  place every time and started again on every launch. That add-on now comes
  with the studio.
- First-time setup now asks what to download of the starter models: all of
  them, only the two files a Krea 2 model you bring yourself needs (about
  5 GB), or none. Before, the only way to say no was to close the window, which
  left setup unfinished. The two files can be fetched later from the studio
  folder; the manual shows how.
- A model you add that is missing files it depends on is now listed as "needs
  files" and says which ones, instead of appearing ready and then failing.
- Setup no longer downloads a starter file you have already put in your
  models folder.
